found.title: Rulers the Codex calls beasts or things are drawn as people
found.text: The ruler models are robed giants (their line-ups were accepted on 2026-11-15, STATUS “Decided”), but the Codex (climb/rulers.md) describes many of them otherwise: the Bell Below “the harbour's old bell” (floor 7, in the Tide Judge's figure), the Lantern Leviathan “a great fish” (8), the Lantern Root, a root with an amber lantern (17), the Grey Oak, a dead oak (18), the Mire Heart, a bog (19), and in the Sands the Scarab Colossus “a beetle the size of a house” (21), the Scarab King, its son (22), the Dune Colossus “a giant of sand and stone” (23), the Brass Sphinx “a lion of brass with a woman's face” (24), the Glass Serpent (25). Since the figures are accepted, the likely fix is the Codex's words (these as the realm's people who carry those names, or the Tower's echo of them in a giant's shape); else new models (Blender, one at a time). Yours to say.
